varieties.name: Demon F1
varieties.supplier_notes: Bird-eye type; high Scoville; strong export market.

varieties.name: Long Cayenne
varieties.supplier_notes: Local fresh market; lower input cost.

timeline_template.description_en: Sow seed in nursery trays at 0.5cm depth. Slow germinator — 14-21 days.
timeline_template.description_sw: Panda mbegu trei kina 0.5cm. Inachelewa kuotesha siku 14-21.

timeline_template.description_en: Spray for thrips and aphids — chili attracts both heavily.
timeline_template.description_sw: Nyunyuza dawa ya thrips na vidudu.
CAN ya pili wakati wa maua.

timeline_template.description_en: Pick when fruits are firm and turning red. Wear gloves.
timeline_template.description_sw: Vuna pilipili zikiwa nyekundu. Vaa gloves.
timeline_template.tip_en: Pick every 5-7 days. Plant produces 6-9 months.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Vuna kila siku 5-7. Mmea hutoa miezi 6-9.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Grade A: uniform color, no blemishes, 5-8cm length. Grade B: minor flaws.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: 10kg crates for fresh; 25kg sacks for sun-dried export.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: Sun-dry to 10% moisture for storage. Fresh: 5-7°C up to 3 weeks.
post_harvest.storage_tips_sw: Anika hadi 10% maji kwa kuhifadhi. Fresh: 5-7°C wiki 3.

diseases.symptoms_en: Silvery streaked leaves, distorted new growth, flower drop, in dry spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Majani yenye michirizi ya fedha, ukuaji uliopinda, maua kuanguka.
diseases.treatment_en: Lambda-cyhalothrin-class at threshold; blue sticky traps for monitoring. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za lambda-cyhalothrin wakati wamezidi; mitego ya bluu kwa uchunguzi. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Monitor during dry spells, preserve natural enemies.
diseases.prevention_sw: Chunguza wakati wa kiangazi, hifadhi maadui wa asili.
diseases.scanner_notes: Silvery streaks distinguish thrips from virus mottling.

diseases.symptoms_en: Colonies curl new growth; honeydew on leaves; check undersides of young leaves.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Makundi yanakunja majani machanga; utomvu majani; chunguza chini ya majani.
diseases.treatment_en: Squash early colonies; registered products only if spreading. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Ponda makundi ya mwanzo; nyunyuza tu ikiwa yanaenea. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Weekly underside scouting, natural enemies first.
diseases.prevention_sw: Chunguza chini ya majani kila wiki, maadui wa asili kwanza.
diseases.scanner_notes: Underside photo with the colony visible.

diseases.symptoms_en: Sunken dark spots on ripening fruit, pink ooze in humidity.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa meusi yaliyozama kwenye matunda yanayoiva, ute wa pinki.
diseases.treatment_en: Azoxystrobin-class at flowering and fruit set in wet weather. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za azoxystrobin wakati wa maua na matunda kukaa mvua nyingi. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Dry handling, no overhead watering, remove debris.
diseases.prevention_sw: Shika pakavu, usimwagilie kutoka juu, ondoa mabaki.
diseases.scanner_notes: Fruit close-up at colour break; wet-season timing.

diseases.symptoms_en: Green wilt of one side, no recovery, milky ooze from a cut stem in water.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Kunyauka kwa kijani upande mmoja, hakuna kupona, ute mweupe kutoka shina.
diseases.treatment_en: None — rogue and destroy; long rotation away from solanaceous crops. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — ng'oa na uteketeze; zungusha mbali na solanaceous. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Certified seed, clean tools, avoid flooding.
diseases.prevention_sw: Mbegu zilizothibitishwa, vifaa safi, epuka mafuriko.
diseases.scanner_notes: Cut-stem ooze test is the verification.

diseases.symptoms_en: White dusting on leaves in warm-dry spells.
diseases.treatment_en: Sulphur-class products at first dusting, cool morning hours. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za salfa mara inapoanza, asubuhi baridi. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: White powder on leaf surfaces; warm-dry weather.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Steady urban demand year-round; grade by colour and firmness. Dry-chili channel pays a premium for red mature fruit.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Mahitaji ya mijini mwaka mzima; panga daraja kwa rangi na uimara. Pilipili kavu hulipa zaidi.
market_notes.price_notes_en: 60–150 KES per kg green, dry chili higher (November 2026). One of the steadier vegetable prices in the market.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: KES 60–150 kwa kilo mbichi, kavu zaidi (Novemba 2026). Bei thabiti zaidi sokoni.
